steps.content: The room's lights on, the person in the seat curls up a bit.
Only after seeing it's you, does she reveal her face from behind her arms.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Are you going to catch me?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Just like those people.
Yao's eyes fixate on you, her mouth nervously pursing. Small flames explode around her occasionally, and you can even see her shoulders heaving with her breaths.
During this time, she has almost grown into the appearance you first met her.
Only now, there's a wall between you two. You can't give her a comforting hug when she's uneasy, like when you first brought her back to the Bureau.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm here just to figure out what exactly happened... See, I've never hurt you, have I?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't mind what they said. They don't know what happened in Sunsink, so they were just... uninformed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's no one else here. Everyone's out, so it's just us. You can rest a little, okay?
You tone is slow and careful, as you've always been when talking to her.
Yao doesn't answer, continuing to bury her face.
test
test
test
test
test
test
You flip through the stack of investigation report hastily prepared by the staff, reading it carefully.
Aside from routine physical examination data, the rest are mostly records of abnormal behavior reports and complaints.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: First, can you tell me, is everything alright? Anything feel off?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ...No. Everything's fine.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I'm fine.
Fine... really?
The report in your hands shows that Yao's abnormal behavior has been ongoing for a while.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We all thought she was just having a stress response from your long-time leave.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But besides you, she hardly listens to anyone else, often denying what she did, which really causes headaches for other staff.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: During the time you were away in the WhiteSands, her mood was quite unstable, showing hostility towards anyone who approached her, like... a wild critter encountering humans.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: She would scratch other people's hands, pull their hair, and also liked to play with fire, causing damage in the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: And more...
Nightingale, while handing you the report, summarized Yao's abnormal state during this period, which sounds like quite a headache.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I don't know if it's just me, but these days, sometimes she acts like the Apostles of Ashes. We're unable to communicate with her, like she's not even in a normal human state...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The worst incident was this most recent outburst. She seemed desperate to <color=#fb9259>escape</color> here. Chief, I'm worried if...

steps.speaker: Ring Research Institute
steps.content: After all, she was born from an Apostle of Ashes. When she grows up, will she become human, or turn into a "Sun Crow"... Can the Chief give a definite answer?
Could it be that Yao also showed abnormalities in this alarm of the Tide of Ashes, which we couldn't find the source of?
You put down the report and look at Yao seriously.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You don't have to be nervous with me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know, you've always listened to me, right?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Yes... I... I do.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then, would you tell me why did you scratch others?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: They... when they came back from outside, I saw some bugs on them, so I wanted to help get rid of them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I see... Then why did you pull everyone's hair?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ...The wind. It was the wind that messed up their hair. I was just trying to help them tidy up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Okay. Now, why abuse your powers and damage equipment with fire?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ...'Cause this place is too small.
Yao mutters softly, her eyes darting around somewhat guiltily.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: It was just an accident. I just touched those things, very lightly... and they... somehow started burning.
You let out a sigh.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Personnel dispatched from outside always go through rest and inspection, so there shouldn't be any bugs sticking to them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Next time you see someone's hair messed up, just reminding them would be enough.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As for this place being too small...
You recall the super large playground specially allocated to the Bureau by FAC—of course, compared to nature, it's definitely still too small.
The creatures outside, the weather outside, the small rooms that feel constricting after being called by instinct.
Yao is not good at lying, you completely understand the thoughts behind these words.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So... you really want to go outside the Bureau, right?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I... I just...
Yao's eyes lower, like a child who has done something wrong, waiting fearfully for punishment.
You quickly soften your tone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's okay, they will get it, and I'm not here to blame you, I promise.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm just worried about you... So, if you really feel anything uncomfortable, just tell me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Like, did you see something, or... hear something, that made you instinctively do those...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: No, I can't remember! Everything in the dream is just—
Yao almost immediately gives a huge no, straightening up, with restless sparks flying out, somewhat disturbed like her master.
But then she shifts her gaze away.

options: Did you dream about the past?

choices.text: Did you dream about the past?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What kind of dream was it? Can you tell me?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: No... I didn't, I... don't remember...

Her eyes flicker, and her hands twist together, her brows furrowed as she evidently recalls the dream, making you nervous too. You can't help but lean forward slightly, looking directly into those golden eyes.

options: Yao, tell me, this is important.

choices.text: Yao, tell me, this is important.

steps.content: In her dream, did she see the seer of Eastia, or... the Sun Crow destroying the seer?
Unable to escape your gaze, she bites her lip and finally speaks.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ...I dreamed that I was... standing high, even touching the sky, fighting... fighting monsters... Nothing else, really. Nothing else...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: The me in the dream is different from me now, it's my past. I... I can remember it all. And when I do, I won't blaze fires, and I won't hurt others...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Could you... wait for me? ...I will become that seer that is safe for everyone, I promise... Could you, just wait...?

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I'm regaining my memories, I am!
Yao stammers, also trying hard to gather her feathers and little sparks, trying to make herself appear as the mature and respected seer she mentioned.
But this lie is even clumsier than the previous ones, and you see through it instantly. You also regret your impatience just now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It okay if you can't remember. It's okay if you can't change back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I didn't mean to make you change back, to be that seer once again that I take care of you so long.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I didn't realize those questions would make you so uneasy, or fear your own instincts, even. I'm sorry.
Yao is somewhat surprised by your apology.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I thought... you would blame me...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, how could I? But after this, you are gonna apologize to every one, okay?
Yao nods, looking somewhat embarrassed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So now, can you tell me what's really on your mind?
Yao's hands grasp her own arms, encircling herself under her wings, as if this could give her the courage to speak her mind.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: ...I'm sorry. I lied to you... About those dreams...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I dreamed I became a woman... wearing strange clothes, standing high in the sky, holding a sword, fighting against a big bird on fire like me...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: But I also dreamed, quite the opposite...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: That I was the monster attacking her, burning her with fire, tearing her apart with my claws. I dreamed I... ate her...
Yao's expression is pained, she closes her eyes and shakes her head, seemingly trying to fling those chaotic voices and images out of her mind.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: After you left, I started having these dreams. I'm scared. I'm afraid to sleep. Then in the daytime, I heard voices, too many times that I don't know which ones are real, and which ones are not...

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: And some voices are like... chaotic monsters. They call me, saying that <color=#fb9259>I don't belong here</color>.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Afterwards, there's a voice in my mind constantly shouting at me to go outside, to go... to the Tide of Ashes! To the Apostles of Ashes!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But you didn't listen to them. You stayed, you're by my side.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: But I know, this time you went out for the Tide of Ashes, to find those Apostles, to eliminate them for good.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: I know the Tide of Ashes, the Apostles—they are all your enemies.

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: So I'm afraid... I'll become your enemy, become one of them.
She bends in pain, almost curling up in the interrogation chair.
Golden eyes reflect your face. In the past, similar eyes in dreams watched you, even the struggling souls long dead tried to pass messages to you, to fight the Mania disaster with you.
Now, the same bright as the sun eyes are once again covered with mist, the person in front of you is still tormented by the Tide of Ashes.
You can't help but feel grief.

options: You'll never be a deceiving monster.

choices.text: You'll never be a deceiving monster.

steps.content: You slowly organize your words.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They don't understand the past—the seer from before, she was even more deceptive than you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your clumsy little lies are nothing compared to the Great Seer.
You straighten your posture.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No matter what else you're still doubting about me, the memories, experiences, and feelings of our life together are real.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The shackles link us together, I will continue to help you suppress the contamination within you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't care what you think you are, but I can accompany you, until you find out who you really are.
You stand up, crossing the invisible wall between you and her, and take her hand.
Yao flinches like a startled bird, the flames beside her suddenly blossom.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If we were outside, I think I should give you a hug.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't be afraid, Yao.
Yao finally shows the smile you've longed to see for so long, she instinctively stretches out her hand, seemingly wanting to respond to that hug you just mentioned.

steps.speaker: Door Slam
steps.content: Bang!!!!
Chief! Get away from her!! She's very dangerous right now!!
The warm atmosphere lasts only a few seconds before FAC combatants burst in, making you frown.
Yao, sitting in the interrogation chair, is startled by the sudden change, and the flames around her burst uncontrollably, burning you who were holding her hand.
Seeing you burned by the flames, the warriors nearby become even more agitated. They surround Yao, isolating you from her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Please wait, my interrogation isn't over yet, and also, I didn't call for backup.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: It was after we received the search results and analyzed them that we determined the need to assist the Chief and defend against Sinner Yao.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What search results? How come I don't know about this?!
The leading combatant hands you a report, densely filled with search results and conjectures.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: We urgently deployed and thoroughly searched WhiteSands and DisCity in a short time, but didn't find any large Apostle matching the alarm.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: However, based on the power level, within this range, only one person could trigger such an alarm from the system.
The FAC personnel glance at the surrounded Yao, speaking with a serious tone.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: Paradeisos reviewed the report you received before entering, and they confirmed that the Sinner detained within the Bureau, Yao, is the Apostle who triggered the alarm!

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: She's habitually deceitful, and this innocent appearance now is also her guise to deceive you so that you get close to her and she can hurt you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If she wanted to harm me, there had been plenty of opportunities before.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Moreover, the shackles have been put on, she can't harm me, and also, I believe she doesn't have such intentions.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: But is she worth your trust?!

The leader raises their voice, the combatants raise their weapons, surrounding Yao. Outside, footsteps and voices of discussion go back and forth, everyone is on guard against the person at the very center of the room.
The air is filled with anger and fear, and with clear hostility. Yao, who was originally scared and curled up on the chair, now suddenly stands up, standing in front of everyone.
The flames around her become more visible, exploding little by little inside the interrogation room.
A peculiar gray gradually climbs up Yao's limbs, feathers splay outwards, the tips sharp, completely taking on a stance for attack.

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: Monster... Monster! She indeed is a monster!

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: Don't come any closer!!!
In the chaos, some couldn't help but shout out, raising their guns at Yao.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Calm down! Don't provoke her!

steps.speaker: Yao
steps.content: Why... why do you see me as your enemy?

steps.speaker: FAC Combatant
steps.content: All personnel on alert!! The subject Sinner has fallen into chaos! Prepare for battle!!!
For a moment, the interrogation room is in complete disarray. You want to rush over and grab Yao's hand, but no matter what, you can't touch her.
She struggles between weapons and armor, unleashing her Mania and power.
She looks at you, her eyes conveying an indiscernible emotion.

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: A large Tide of Ashes detected!! Attention all personnel!! A large Tide of Ashes detected!! Attention all personnel!!
The piercing alarm sound brings everyone back to their senses, they stare at Yao, holding onto anything they can hold tightly.
The temperature in the room suddenly drops, Yao's expression calms down, as if called upon by something, she suddenly retracts her flared feathers, standing tall and looking up.

She looks afar, her gaze passing through the humans surrounding her, through layers of concrete walls, to a world even you can't see; listening intently, amidst the loud alarms and chaotic shouts, hearing what you cannot.
You can't feel everything she perceives, but you instinctively feel a chilling panic throughout your body.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yao!! Are you hearing that chaotic voice again?! Don't listen to it! Stay with me!
You push through everyone, rushing to Yao's front. You extend your hand towards her, red light converging in your palm, shackles almost triggering.
But she just gives you a glance.
In an instant, the world quiets down, through those golden pupils you feel cold for the first time, a kind of irreversible sorrow of realization.
She spreads her feathers amidst the flames, howling towards the sky, breaking through the crowd, rushing outwards.
It was like a swift blade made of fire that no one can stop, or dare to stop.
The moment she gazes at you, everyone feels it.
An unparalleled power, monstrous, an Apostle-level Mania power.
